description: This file defines the S3EndpointMiddleware class, which is crucial for managing and customizing the endpoint URLs used for S3 requests within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles different configurations such as accelerate, dual-stack, and path style. It is an internal middleware component used to modify request URIs based on various settings and conditions.

classes.name: S3EndpointMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware component for handling S3-specific endpoint URL customizations, supporting features like accelerate, dual-stack, and path-style addressing for AWS S3 requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper function that instantiates the S3EndpointMiddleware with specified region, endpoint provider, and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the middleware with a next handler, region, options (like enablements for path style, dual stack, accelerate), and optional endpoint provider.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invocation method that modifies the request URI based on endpoint pattern decisions and configurations before passing it to the next handler.

methods.name: endpointPatternDecider
methods.description: Determines which endpoint pattern to apply (host style, path style, dualstack, accelerate, etc.) based on command and request specifics.

methods.name: canAccelerate
methods.description: Checks if the current request/command is eligible for S3 acceleration features.

methods.name: getBucketStyleHost
methods.description: Constructs the host for bucket-style addressing.

methods.name: applyHostStyleEndpoint
methods.description: Applies host style endpoint URI modifications for a request.

methods.name: applyPathStyleEndpointCustomizations
methods.description: Modifies the request URI for path style endpoint, particularly for special operations like WriteGetObjectResponse.

methods.name: applyDualStackEndpoint
methods.description: Configures the request to use a dualstack endpoint.

methods.name: applyAccelerateEndpoint
methods.description: Modifies the request URI for accelerate endpoint patterns.

methods.name: getBucketlessPath
methods.description: Removes the bucket name from the URI path for certain endpoint configurations.

methods.name: applyEndpoint
methods.description: Applies custom endpoint logic, including handling ARNs and restrictions on dualstack or outposts.
